question: Who agreed to acquire Capterra in 2026?

hits.title: G2 expands Buyer Intent across four software discovery platforms, delivering up to 2x more signals.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-01-01] G2 Digital Markets acquired Capterra Inc on Jan 1st '26. This expansion is the direct result of G2's acquisition of Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp (now called G2 Digital Markets) from Gartner in early 2026.
hits.summary: G2 Digital Markets acquired Capterra Inc on Jan 1st '26.

hits.title: G2 to Acquire Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner
hits.snippet: [acquires] The G2 is planning to acquire Capterra Inc. G2 to acquire Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner.
hits.summary: The G2 is planning to acquire Capterra Inc.

hits.title: Capterra Names Claire Alexander as New General Manager
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2015-01-01 | $206.2 million] Gartner Inc. acquired Capterra Inc for $206M on Jan 1st '15. Founded in 1999, Capterra was acquired in 2015 by Gartner, Inc.
hits.summary: Gartner Inc. acquired Capterra Inc for $206M on Jan 1st '15.

extract.answer: G2 Digital Markets agreed to acquire Capterra from Gartner in 2026.

accuracy.note: Answer names G2 as the acquirer, matching the gold cell despite extra wording.
